'''Telgordo Travel''' was a company that operated a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of [[Starship/Legends|starships]], including the [[Passenger liner/Legends|passenger liner]], ''[[Telgordo's Pride]]''. Telgordo Travel was a subsidiary of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], and one of the most influential shipping firms in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] that was run by some of the most trusted men and women in the Empire. As a result, Telgordo Travel vessels did not have to stop at checkpoints, and their passengers were generally rich Imperials and their retinues.
